scopeInterpretation: Assess intelligent design as a legitimate scientific explanation for biological origins, including information, causal inference, explanatory methods, research productivity and freedom of inquiry as actually argued. Atkins challenges that inference and its scientific status; do not require a completed origin-of-life theory just to criticize design.
